ns2:section.sectionText: The goal of this course is to inform students about a variety of career-oriented topics in computer science and assist them in planning and preparing for the next step in their career. This will cover career opportunities and pathways for those with undergraduate and/or graduate degrees in computer science and will include discussion of aspects of graduate studies such as admissions, funding, and success in graduate school. The course will also cover practical issues such as internships, resumes/CVs, finding a job, interviewing, job negotiations, company work environments. Presentations about these topics will involve a variety of invited speakers in an interactive seminar environment.
